source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the if-else statement (PDF 42).

blocks.text: if-else statement mein do raaste hote hain: condition (shart) True ho to pehla block chalta hai, False ho to else wala block.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh if-else ki shakal (syntax) hai, poora program nahi.
"if condition:": yahan apni shart likhein, aakhir mein colon.
"# code to run if the condition is true": shart True ho to chalne wala code; 4 spaces aage (indented).
"else:": if ke barabar margin par; is ke saath koi shart nahi likhi jati.
"# code to run if the condition is false": shart False ho to chalne wala code; yeh bhi indented.
Dono blocks mein se hamesha sirf ek hi chalta hai. Block mein sirf comment ho to IndentationError aata hai; asli code likhein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan bhi "If condition:" bare I se chhapti hai; sahi if condition: hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"temperature = 15": temperature mein 15.
"if temperature > 30:": 15 > 30 False hai.
"print("It's a hot day ")": if ka block; shart False hai is liye chhor diya jata hai.
"else :": shart False hone par yeh raasta chalta hai (colon se pehle space se farq nahi parta).
"print("It's not a hot day " )": else ka block chalta hai.
Output: "It's not a hot day " (aakhir mein ek space bhi hai jo nazar nahi aata).
Khud try karein: temperature = 35 kar ke Run karein: ab "It's a hot day " print hoga.
temperature = 15 hai, to temperature > 30 False hai aur else wala block chalta hai: "It’s not a hot day " print hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: number juft (even) ya taaq (odd) hai, check karne ka if-else statement likhein.
blocks.explanation: 2 se divide karne par bachne wala baqi (remainder) dekhein: if num % 2 == 0: print("Even") else: print("Odd").
